policy: Preserve the published Bulgarian statutory wording. Record cross-instrument legal status and successor relationships separately; do not silently rewrite a national law because it cites an older EU instrument.

dependencies.status_note: In Landeshauptstadt Wiesbaden, C-61/22, EU:C:2024:251, the Court declared Regulation (EU) 2019/1157 invalid and maintained its effects until a successor entered into force, subject to a maximum period ending 31 December 2026. Regulation (EU) 2025/1208 entered into force on 10 July 2025 and now sets the EU standards for residence cards for non-EU family members exercising free movement.

primary_sources.title: CJEU Grand Chamber judgment, Landeshauptstadt Wiesbaden, C-61/22, 21 March 2024
